name: Contact / requirements form
purpose: Collect a sales enquiry or tender from a prospect comparing platforms, with reassurance copy and review badges beside a (static) form.
description: Legacy green-theme bordered block in container-large (/contact-us): a 40% / 60% grid (one column <=767, gap 2rem). Left: 1.75rem H3, two grey paragraphs separated by a blank line, and a row of three review badges. Right: a static HubSpot-footprint form (fixed 300x1020px, white Helvetica labels): intro line, four text inputs, an employee-count select, a file input, a requirements textarea, an empty captcha-sized box and a Submit button. Submit is prevented; nothing is sent.

evidenceNotes: ContactPage.jsx overrides heading and paragraphs; the form intro and badges are component defaults.
Badges are real files (/assets/badge-capterra.svg, badge-g2.svg, badge-software-advice.svg, alt 'Review badge'), not ; the sample uses placeholderLabel 'Review badge' (the alt text).
Field labels, the select options, the textarea placeholder and the Submit label are hard-coded in the component, not props.
